EL001.rule: ELIGIBLE ONLY IF: Age at least 18 year

EL002.rule: ELIGIBLE ONLY IF: Histologically confirmed primary TCC of the urinary bladder is present

EL003.rule:
ELIGIBLE ONLY IF: (T2 to T4 disease is one of ['T2 to T4'] AND N0 is one of ['N0'] AND M0 is one of ['M0'] AND (CT imaging is present AND (biopsy is present OR transurethral
resection is present)))

EL004.rule: ELIGIBLE ONLY IF: ECOG Performance status is one of ['0', '1']

EL005.rule: ELIGIBLE ONLY IF: (GFR at least 60 mls/min OR [IF baseline eGFR at least 50 and less than 60 mls/min THEN (EDTA result at least 60 mls/min OR (EDTA result at least 55 and less than 60 mls/min AND UNRESOLVED requirement: 'discuss with CI' {NOT EXECUTABLE}))])

EL010.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: EDTA result less than 55 mls/min

EL012.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: ECOG Performance Status at least 2

EL013.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: (Lymph node involvement is present OR metastatic disease is present)

EL015.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: (peripheral neuropathy is one of ['Active'] AND Grade at least 2)

EL016.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: Active secondary cancers is present

EL017.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: severe hypersensitivity reaction at least 3 [qualifier: History of; to polysorbate 80 containing drugs]

EL018.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: Other concurrent serious illness or medical conditions is present

EL019.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: (Neutrophils at most 1.5 [qualifier: at enrolment] {NOT EXECUTABLE} OR Haemoglobin at most 10 g/dl [qualifier: at enrolment] OR Platelets at most 100 [qualifier: at enrolment] {NOT EXECUTABLE} OR Total bilirubin greater than 1.5 times upper limit of normal (ULN) [qualifier:

EL020.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: (Electrocardiogram (ECG) evidence is one of ['uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmias', 'angina pectoris', 'hypertension'] OR history of congestive heart failure is present OR myocardial infarction occurs within 6 month before enrolment [assessed: within last 6 months])

EL021.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: Uncontrolled diabetes mellitus is present

EL022.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: Active uncontrolled gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD) is present

EL023.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: Active infection requiring systemic antibiotic or anti-fungal medication is present

EL025.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: strong inhibitors of cytochrome P450 3A4/5 is present [qualifier: Concurrent or planned treatment]

EL027.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: strong inducers of cytochrome P450 3A4/5 is present [qualifier: Concurrent or planned treatment]

EL028.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: Contraindications to cisplatin is present

EL029.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: (reproductive potential is present AND an accepted and effective method of contraception is absent [qualifier: not implementing])

EL030.rule: PROHIBITED: EXCLUDED IF: yellow fever vaccine is present [qualifier: Concurrent]
